verses.text: So you, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
You heard me teach many things in front of many witnesses. Pass these things on to people you can trust, who will be able to teach others too.
Share in suffering like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
No soldier on duty gets mixed up in everyday business. He wants to please the officer who chose him.
In the same way, an athlete does not win the prize unless he keeps the rules.
The farmer who works hard should be the first to get a share of the crops.
Think about what I am saying. The Lord will help you understand all these things.
Remember Jesus Christ, who was raised from the dead and came from the family of David. This is the Good News I preach.
For this Good News I am suffering, even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God's word is not chained.
So I put up with everything for the sake of God's chosen people, so that they too may be saved in Christ Jesus and have glory that lasts for ever.
Here is a saying you can trust: "If we died with him, we will also live with him.
If we keep going, we will also rule with him. If we say we do not know him, he will also say he does not know us.
If we are not faithful, he stays faithful, because he cannot go against who he is."
Keep reminding God's people of these things. Warn them in front of God not to argue about words. Such arguing does no good. It only ruins those who listen.
Do your best to present yourself to God as one he approves, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, who handles the true message correctly.
Keep away from godless empty talk, because people who do that will become more and more ungodly.
Their teaching will spread like a disease that eats away the body. Hymenaeus and Philetus are among them.
They have wandered away from the truth. They say that the rising from the dead has already happened, and they are destroying the faith of some people.
But God's strong foundation stands firm, and it is sealed with these words: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from what is wrong."
In a large house there are not only things made of gold and silver, but also things made of wood and clay. Some are for special use and some for ordinary use.
If anyone makes himself clean from these wrong things, he will be like a special dish. He will be made holy, useful to the Master, and ready for every good work.
Run away from the evil desires of youth. Chase after what is right, and after faith, love and peace, together with those who call on the Lord with a pure heart.
Have nothing to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they lead to fights.
The Lord's servant must not fight. Instead, he must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and patient.
He must gently correct those who oppose him. Maybe God will help them turn from their sins and come to know the truth fully.
Then they will come to their senses and escape from the devil's trap. He has caught them to make them do what he wants.
